removed_items.difficulty_reason: The lemma asserts existence and uniqueness of the tensor product as the module representing bilinear maps, with the commuting diagram drawn in the statement (statement lines 1932-1953). The proof builds the module as a quotient of the free module on the product by the bilinearity relations, extends a bilinear map along the basis to get the universal arrow, and then produces the unique comparing isomorphism between two solutions by evaluating the two composites on generators (proof lines 1960-1993). Quotienting the free module by exactly the relations needed for well-definedness is the step that carries existence. H2.
